findings: Viewed five actual native candidates next to frozen battle holding and full original-resolution genuine master. Same curly-haired human, plain boots/leather forearm, modest shoulder plate and hooked work implement. Green dosing glass and plum harness preserve skin and worn iron.

Complete transparent map/encounter views are separately painted directions. Large portrait retains head/shoulders;32px compact face/arm/hook details require final interface legibility. Base equipment is lighter than the braced/plated upgrade.

Viewed five actual native candidates, frozen battle holding and genuine master. Single horizontal copper pressure cylinder, riveted box torso, hose/nozzle, claw and mechanical feet remain coherent. Green inspection cap/nozzle and restrained purple fittings match modest base equipment.
No humanoid robot head, second creature or extra main nozzle. Full-body views retain transparent margins and complete feet. Absence of upgrade external reservoirs keeps the base visibly simpler.

Viewed five actual native candidates, frozen battle holding and genuine master. Same shaggy-haired human, hook, bolted forearm braces, shoulder plates and metal boots. Green hip reagent and purple straps match battle without glowing skin.

Distinct encounter directions preserve arm/boot silhouettes. Added bracing and greaves materially distinguish the upgrade from Chem Ravager.32px miniature buckles and dosing details are not claimed fully legible without the client.

Viewed five actual native candidates, frozen battle holding and complete separated-v2 genuine master. Six painted subjects now separate cleanly; unused sixth excluded. This repairs earlier adjoining portrait-tank cells without synthetic cleanup.

Two tall green glass reservoirs, purple bands and heavier brown riveted chassis match battle and distinguish the upgrade. Single main nozzle/claw/feet remain coherent in independently painted encounter directions.32px twin-green reservoir read is visible; game outline/light remains pending.
